verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity has a dedicated first-party guide that says Stripe generates events every time a verification session changes status, and it walks through setting up webhooks so your app is notified when results are available (docs-15, docs-6). This clearly covers subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: the excerpts do not list specific event types or document signature verification/retry behavior, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the webhook integration.
